regions.merged_text: God bless you Father Ambrose My Dear Rev. Confrere. God bless you and yours these days at once of God's great mercy and of supremely tragic, international history. It was only last night that I got to read your pathetic letter of a few days ago. Why apolo- gize for such a letter? I wrote poor, dear Fr. Fred. some months back but never heard from him. I am sending you herewith a copy of a "rhyne letter" which I hoped would help him; but like my own Rev. Fr. (MAUrice) Joachim, O.F.M. Cap - ten months a novice - to whom the same was originally written (Like Fr.) he probably did not appreciate. I was hardly sur- prisec or disapointed at receiving no response. Now, however, we shall try something else which I trust will work something towards bringing out the blessing contained in every cross and every be- reavement. I am inscribing Fr. Fred. in the list of our "emergency cases" which Thanks be to God has surptised ... in more than one example. But neither is the foregoing anywhere the limit or climax of our suggestions. I am sure the following details of my Rev. Brother's case will and the out- come thereof will offer you and your poordear Mother and friends example at once and encouragement not to say as I hope it will asured confidence.
